title: 3 Wheel Pet Stroller With Easy One-Click Quick Fold, Mesh Window, Washable Cushion, For Medium Dogs, Gray
body_html:
Features:

  • - Folds in seconds with a one-click mechanism for effortless transport and storage
  • - Large all-terrain wheels and a dual brake ensure a smooth, stable ride
  • - Roomy interior with panoramic mesh windows ensures comfort and great ventilation
  • - Low rear entry and two safety leashes provide easy and secure access
  • - Made of robust 600D Oxford cloth to resist wear and scratches
  • - Hook-and-loop canopy closure allows for quick, one-handed access to your pet
  • - Features a large back pocket, keeping all your essentials within easy reach
  • - Suitable for medium dogs up to 44 lbs. and body length no more than 20.1"

Specification:

  • - Color: Gray, Black
  • - Material: Oxford Fabric, Metal
  • - Overall Dimension: 36.2" L x 24.8" W x 37.4" H
  • - Folding Size: 35.8" L x 24.8" W x 15.4" H
  • - Internal Cabin Size: 29.9" L x 17.7" W x 24.8" H
  • - Cushion Size: 28.3" L x 16.9" W
  • - Front Wheel Size: 6.7" Dia.
  • - Rear Wheel Size: 9.6" Dia.
  • - Maximum Load: 44 lbs.
  • - Item Label: D00-232V00GY

Package Includes:

  • - 1 x Dog Stroller
  • - 1 x Manual
